name: Grace Life Baptist Church
researchNote: 2026-07-28: closure confirmed by the church's own site text (via search index) plus a dead domain (gracelifebc.com -> 127.0.0.1, connection refused). Kept as a closed record rather than deleted; delete only if the directory should hide closed churches.
theologicalNotes: CLOSED (December 2025). Formerly Court Street Baptist Church of Port Huron, founded 1939; relocated and served as a Reformed Baptist congregation in Clyde Township from 2012 until it dissolved in December 2025. Officially held the New Hampshire Baptist Confession of Faith while also teaching from and recommending the 1689 London Baptist Confession. Pastors in its final years: Tim Floyd, Dean Butterfield, Kyle Floyd, Matt McPhillips. Website gracelifebc.com is dead - the domain now resolves to 127.0.0.1 - so the URL and the stale contact email were cleared.
description: A Reformed Baptist church in Clyde Township, MI.
